title: Beaumont four-storey commercial/residential development permit package: unprotected-opening table and building code analysis
jurisdiction: City of Beaumont, Alberta (development authority named on file; building-permit AHJ not stated in the file)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2019 and supplements, as stated by the applicant's code analysis (p.34). The file does not cite NBC(AE) 2023 2nd printing.
document_date: Undated on the pages read. PDF metadata: created 2025-01-14, modified 2025-01-22. Permit 2022-098 amendment referenced as January 2025 in a search summary only.

facts.text: The City conditionally approved amendments to Development Permit 2022-098 for a Permitted Use within the Commercial District, subject to Land Use Bylaw 944-19.
The amendment area removes 5 trees, 4 shrubs and 1 bicycle stall to provide 10 small compact parking stalls. The file states no parking variance is required.
Condition 14 states the proposed development must meet or exceed the requirements of the current Alberta Building Codes, Alberta Fire Codes and NFPA1141.

The code analysis states the construction procedures are to be carried out in accordance with the National Building Code Alberta Edition 2019 and its supplements, with NBC AE 2019 Parts 3-8 of Division B applying (Division A 1.3.3.2).
The analysis describes a 4-storey commercial/residential building with 962 m2 per storey and 3,848 m2 total floor area.

Major occupancies are stated as Group D business and personal services and Group C residential apartments. Classification blocks read Group C per 3.2.2.51 and Group D per 3.2.2.59, each up to 4 storeys and sprinklered.

Table 3.2.3.1, sprinklered, Groups C (2nd to 4th floor), north face: code limiting distance 3 m, actual 3 m, exposing building face 385 m2, allowed unprotected openings 22%, provided 24%, footnote '2% of north wall provided with protected opening'.
The same table, Groups C (2nd to 4th floor), gives east 22% allowed / 6% provided, south 100% allowed / 25% provided, and west 66% allowed / 7% provided.

Table 3.2.3.1, sprinklered, Groups A and D (main floor), north face: limiting distance 3 m, exposing building face 175 m2, allowed 26%, provided 30%, footnote '4% of north wall provided with protected opening'. East 100% / 12%; west 100% / 10%.
In the main-floor table the south row shows 9 m code and 10.5 m actual limiting distance, 175 m2 face area and 100% allowed, with no provided-percentage value.
The main-floor table heading reads 'Groups A and D', while the classification blocks list Groups C and D.
Fire alarm is stated as required per 3.2.4.1. Major occupancy separation between Groups C and D is stated as 1 hour per Table 3.1.3.1.
Wall assembly notes on the drawing sheet cite NBC AE 2019 Appendix A Table 9.10.3.1.A (a Part 9 assembly table) for 1 HR F.R.R. walls, while section 4 classifies the building under Part 3 articles.
The code analysis states the maximum travel distance as 40 m for Group D (3.4.2.5(1)(b)) and 45 m for Group C (3.4.2.5(1)(c)), and a total building occupant load of 201 persons.
